title: A Witness for the Alibi
author: Isandro Whitlock
blurb: Astrid Blackwood, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
